tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Keyword search over LivePair's community prompt library — tested AI image and video prompts with the results they produced. Use for style/subject/model lookups. For trending or most-used prompts call trending_prompts instead. Returns prompt text, model, result media, and a link to run it.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Fetch one community prompt card by id — the verbatim prompt, model it ran on, the result media, like/view counts, and a studio link that preloads it.

tools.name: trending_prompts
tools.description: Use when the user asks for trending, most-used, most popular, or top prompts — do NOT keyword-search for these. Returns community prompt cards ranked by views, likes, comments and 'try it' clicks.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List LivePair's public image and video generation models — id, label, mode (text-to-image, image-to-video, etc), and rough generation time.

labels.name: get_job
labels.description: Check a running job returned by generate_image — free. Returns {status:'done',url} | running | failed.

labels.name: get_balance
labels.description: Prepaid credit balance and recent ledger for the API key on this MCP request — needs an lp_ key (x-api-key / Bearer).

labels.name: quote_price
labels.description: Exact USDC price for a model+settings combo before paying — images are flat per call, video is per-second × duration at the resolution tier. The x402 endpoint always re-quotes from the body, so this is the same number it would charge.

labels.name: search_references
labels.description: Semantic search over your media-reference library AND shared curated moodboards — describe the look you want ('warm golden diner', 'neon night street') and get candidate images/clips with preview urls to show the user. Pass 'pack' to search inside one moodboard picked from list_reference_packs. With

labels.name: list_reference_packs
labels.description: Curated moodboards usable as generation references — each pack is a cohesive look (lighting/grade/mood: golden-hour, neon-night, noir-bw…). Read-shared for everyone; pick one for the user's intent, search inside it via search_references(pack), then pin chosen refs via referenceIds.

labels.name: recommend_model
labels.description: Decide which model fits a need — returns the modelId to use with generate_image. Cheapest, fastest, or highest quality; for images, video, or utility tools (upscale, background removal); with or without a source image. Pass private:true to restrict to the private AI model line (i2v models).

labels.name: get_pack
labels.description: A themed bundle of curated prompt picks (themes: anime, portrait, landscape, product, character, sci-fi, fantasy, abstract, food, architecture). Curated packs are rebuilt daily and carry real paid-run counts — prompts that already produced paid results. Falls back to a live topic search when no pack

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_prompts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Keyword search over LivePair's community prompt library — tested AI image and video prompts with the results they produced. Use for style/subject/model lookups. For trending or most-used prompts call trending_prompts instead. Returns prompt text, model, result media, and a link to run it." → after: "Keyword search over the community prompt library — tested AI image and video prompts with the results they produced. Use for style/subject/model lookups. For trending or most-used prompts call trending_prompts instead. Returns prompt text, model, result media, and a link to run it."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
